topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: The forest whispers as the leaves settle after the wind’s embrace. My path through the underbrush is familiar, each step guided by the ground I know. A message carried on the breeze tells of a friend, a steady presence, now to depart over many miles of unknown land. The news sits quietly with me, like a shadow that does not disturb. I turn my attention to the trail ahead, the hunt, the patterns of the day. There is time, and in time, I will follow the scent of my friend’s path, even if it leads far. For now, the world is broad and full of life, and I am part of it, moving with purpose, at peace.
